programme_name_es: Máster Universitario en Lógica, Computación e Inteligencia Artificial
language_of_instruction: «Español» - the Universidad de Sevilla programme page gives Spanish as the single language of instruction. No English-taught option stated. HARD BLOCKER for an A0/A1 Spanish speaker.
language_requirement: NOT FOUND (no explicit certificate level stated on the programme page for this title)
tuition_year_of_rates: 2025-26 rates, still in force (Decreto 98/2023 as modified by Decreto 142/2025); no 2026-27 decree published as of 2026-08-25
non_eu_surcharge: no - Universidad de Sevilla states explicitly: «Como estudiante internacional, abonarás los mismos precios públicos que cualquier otra persona estudiante en la Universidad. El sistema de precios es igualitario y regulado por decreto autonómico, sin distinción por nacionalidad» (cat.us.es). NOTE the legal head-room: Decreto 98/2023 art. 3.2 says «El estudiantado extranjero ... que no sea residente en España abonará los precios ... No obstante, las universidades en que se matricule podrán establecer una variación en el precio de los créditos en cualquier nivel de estudios, sin que el precio correspondiente pueda exceder del 100% del coste del servicio académico» - so a surcharge is authorised in Andalucía but US has not applied one and publishes the opposite.
entry_requirements: Preferred access degrees listed by the programme: Ingeniería/Grado en Informática, Grado en Ingeniería de la Salud, Grado en Matemáticas, Ingeniería/Grado en Telecomunicación, Grado en Ciencias y Técnicas Estadísticas, Grado en Física. 30 plazas per year. Applicants with a non-homologated foreign degree must apply through Fase 1 of the Distrito Único Andaluz calendar.
accepts_engineering_background: EXPLICIT - Ingeniería/Grado en Informática is the first-listed preferred access degree; a Software Engineering degree is squarely in scope.
complementary_credits_required: NOT PUBLISHED IN RUCT at title level (ects_complementos_formativos = null in the register - not the same as 0). AT APPLICANT LEVEL the programme page states the Comisión Académica may require up to 30 ECTS of complementos de formación, normally taken from the Informática or Matemáticas grado, for candidates coming from other related fields. A Software Engineering graduate is in the preferred group, so complementos are unlikely, but the decision is the Comisión's and is made per applicant.
credit_recognition_available: NOT FOUND - the programme page carries no statement on reconocimiento de créditos or advanced standing for a 300-ECTS first degree. The 300 ECTS is relevant here only in the negative sense that it removes any risk of falling short of the 240-ECTS bar; no shortening of the master is offered on the pages read.
application_window_2027: 2026-27 calendar (published; 2027-28 NOT YET PUBLISHED as of 2026-08-25). Fase 1, reserved for holders of a non-homologated foreign degree - THIS CANDIDATE'S ROUTE: solicitudes 13-29 January 2026. Fase 2: 17-26 June 2026. Fase 3: 8-15 September 2026. Do not shift these forward a year yourself; the equivalent Fase 1 for the September 2027 intake would fall in January 2027 but that calendar is not out.
application_rounds: 2026-27 Fase 1 (exclusively for holders of a non-homologated foreign university degree): solicitudes 13-29/01/2026; 1a adjudicación 19/02; 2a 12/03; 3a 09/04
non_eu_early_round_advised: YES and it is compulsory in practice: Fase 1 is «dirigida exclusivamente a personas en posesión de un título universitario extranjero no homologado» and runs in January, five months before the ordinary Fase 2. A Tunisian degree holder must use it.
curriculum_summary: 60 ECTS. RUCT breakdown: 0 obligatorios, 48 optativos, 0 prácticas, 12 TFM - i.e. 48 ECTS of elective coursework in logic/computation/AI foundations plus a 12-ECTS Trabajo Fin de Máster. Theory- and logic-heavy AI master rather than an applied ML one. Taught at the Escuela Técnica Superior de Ingeniería Informática.
notable_faculty_or_lab: Coordinator Joaquín Borrego Díaz (ETSII, Dpto. Ciencias de la Computación e Inteligencia Artificial)
industry_links: NOT FOUND - RUCT records 0 ECTS of prácticas and the programme page names no industry partners.
thesis_or_internship: Thesis only: 12 ECTS Trabajo Fin de Máster. No prácticas (0 ECTS in RUCT).

Additional fees: apertura de expediente académico 59,10 EUR + tarjeta de identidad universitaria 5,70 EUR = 64,80 EUR; a seguro escolar line was not published on the page read. 13,68 EUR/credito, 1a matricula, master universitario no habilitante. Legal base: Decreto 98/2023 (BOJA 84, 05/05/2023) Anexo I, aplicable desde el curso 2023-2024, modificado por Decreto 142/2025 (BOJA 172, 02/09/2025) aplicable desde el curso 2025-2026. La tabla publicada por la Universidad de Sevilla (fct.us.es) cita el Decreto 142/2025 y dice que los precios siguen vigentes hasta que se aprueben nuevos precios publicos. No existe decreto 2026-27 publicado a 2026-08-25. RUCT estado: «Publicado en B.O.E. (TITULACIÓN RENOVADA)», active; verificación 30/09/2010, BOE 16/12/2010, 27/10/2011, 13/08/2019, 02/03/2022; renovación de la acreditación favourable 23/07/2026 (most recent), 17/09/2020, 15/12/2016. MECES 3, RD 1393/2007. LANGUAGE IS THE DECIDING FACTOR: Spanish-only.
